test_title: PYST 57: SSC CPO - General Knowledge and General Awareness (Held on 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following Articles of the Constitution of India lays down the establishment of Public Service Commissions for the Union and for the States?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 315**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 315** establishes **Public Service Commissions** for the **Union and States** in the **Indian Constitution**.
 
• It defines the **framework for the appointment, duties, and powers of these commissions**.
 
• **Public Service Commissions **play a crucial role in conducting **examinations and selecting candidates **for various **government positions**.
 
• They ensure** fair and transparent recruitment processes** in the **public sector**.
 
• The article outlines the principles g**overning the composition** and **functioning of these commissions**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 316**

 
 
• **Article 316** deals with the **appointment of members of Public Service Commissions**.
 
• It sets **qualifications and conditions **for **State Public Service Commission members**.
 
 
 
• **Article 317**
 
 
• **Article 317: **Deals with **removal and suspension** of **Public Service Commission members**.
 
• **Specifies** procedure for **Union and State Public Service Commission members**.
 
 
 
• **Article 318**
 
 
• **Extends Union Public Service Commission rules to State counterparts**.
